detail: decode / scanBuffer / scanHandleSync / pushScanner / view disagree

$plain.push: throw:SourceError:The session needs bytes beyond what was delivered.

triage.analysis: pushScanner/pushValidator: when the last step before EOF was a quantum yield at the end of the delivered bytes, finalize() sees holds() fail (it wants one byte at position == length) and throws SourceError('length_mismatch') instead of stepping the session, which knows the declared length and would answer the CBOR refusal (truncated / embedded). Minimal: pushScanner(3, {top:'any'}, {quantum:1}) fed 821818 -> SourceError length_mismatch; scanBuffer, scanHandleSync (any quantum) and pushScanner with quantum 0 answer SnugFault truncated. The same shared pushSession serves pushValidator: schema 'r = bstr .cbor { a: int }', bytes 43a16162, quantum 1 or 2 -> SourceError; Schema.validate, validateHandleSync and quantum 0/3/4 -> embedded / cbor/truncated. Campaign minimisations: 828100 (pushScanner, quantum 1, one chunk) and d82882540000000000000000000000000000000000000000 (quantum 2). 384 occurrences in the 66.9-minute run; 49 + 1835 more as P1/P5 session-verdict.
